scripts.check: npm run verify:registry && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run contracts:test && npm run test:owner-host
scripts.format: prettier --write src test scripts/*.ts config/*.json README.md AGENTS.md project-context/*.md && forge fmt contracts
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src test scripts/*.ts config/*.json README.md AGENTS.md project-context/*.md && forge fmt --check contracts
scripts.test:owner-host: python3 -m unittest discover -s ops -p 'test_owner_pilot_remote.py' && python3 -m unittest discover -s ops -p 'test_owner_refresh_remote.py' && python3 -m unittest discover -s ops -p 'test_owner_reconcile_remote.py'
